parameters.query: INSERT INTO processed_events (source_system, event_id, webhook_topic) VALUES ('ecommerce', '{{$json.dedup_hash}}', 'carrinho_abandonado') ON CONFLICT (source_system, event_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING event_id;

INSERT INTO clientes (nome, email, whatsapp) VALUES ('{{$('Deduplicar e Sanitizar (SHA-256)').item.json.cliente_nome}}', NULLIF('{{$('Deduplicar e Sanitizar (SHA-256)').item.json.email}}', ''), NULLIF('{{$('Deduplicar e Sanitizar (SHA-256)').item.json.whatsapp}}', '')) ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET whatsapp = EXCLUDED.whatsapp, nome = EXCLUDED.nome, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;

INSERT INTO carrinhos_abandonados (cliente_nome, whatsapp, email, valor_carrinho, link_checkout_recuperacao, tipo_pendencia, status_recuperacao) VALUES ('{{$('Deduplicar e Sanitizar (SHA-256)').item.json.cliente_nome}}', '{{$('Deduplicar e Sanitizar (SHA-256)').item.json.whatsapp}}', '{{$('Deduplicar e Sanitizar (SHA-256)').item.json.email}}', {{$('Deduplicar e Sanitizar (SHA-256)').item.json.valor_total}}, '{{$('Deduplicar e Sanitizar (SHA-256)').item.json.checkout_url}}', 'Carrinho Abandonado', 'Pendente') RETURNING id;

UPDATE carrinhos_abandonados SET status_recuperacao = 'Disparado_WhatsApp', tentativas_contato = tentativas_contato + 1, link_checkout_recuperacao = '{{$('Gerar Link Curto (Shlink)').item.json.shortUrl || $('Deduplicar e Sanitizar (SHA-256)').item.json.checkout_url}}', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = {{$('Persistir no loja_db (PostgreSQL)').item.json.id}};
